text:
🔴 gamescom Opening Night Live 2026 ONL Official Livestream (LIVE NOW!)
Opening Night Live is back for 2026, taking place on Tuesday, August 25. This in-person event will be livestreamed and kicks off the beginning of gamescom. Tune in and check out big trailers, gameplays, and tons of news reveals throughout the night.

ONL will have a 30-minute pre-show prior to the main show, which will run for about two hours. Immediately following Opening Night Live, IGN will be breaking down all the biggest reveals from the show in our own deep-dive ONL post-show!

#IGN #Gaming #gamescom

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Age Twisters - Official Reveal Trailer | gamescom 2026
Here's a look at the Reveal Trailer for Age Twisters, a co-op narrative adventure game developed by Piccolo Studio. Players will solve puzzles and seek the truth of a web of lies in a co-op adventure with a grandfather and granddaughter. Age Twisters is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Humankind 2 - Official Announcement Trailer | gamescom 2026
Take a look at the Humankind 2 announcement trailer for this upcoming historical turn-based strategy game. Build a civilization that spans the ages in Humankind 2. Combine evolving cultures, raise cities, command armies and expand your empire as a changing climate reshapes the world and your path through history. Humankind 2 will be available on PC in 2027.

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Petit Planet - Official Pre-Register Trailer | gamescom 2026
Petit Planet is a new game from miHoYo where players will customize their characters, and live, fish, visit, and get to know others in an adorable world, building their homes and expanding their small worlds to their liking in this cozy cosmic life sim.

author: IGN YouTube
text:
The Blood of Dawnwalker - Official Launch Trailer | gamescom 2026
Every choice you make will shape the world around you. Every life you take carves a new path forward. The Blood of Dawnwalker comes to PC, PS5, Xbox Series X/S, Xbox PC, Xbox Cloud on September 3, 2026.

#IGN #Gaming #gamescom

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Aion 2 - Official Gameplay Trailer | gamescom 2026
Aion 2 is headed to PC on October 5, 2026, and gamescom's Opening Night Live shared with us a new look at the next-gen MMORPG built in Unreal Engine 5.

Aion 2 welcomes thousands of players to a world waiting to be explored across land, sea, and air, extensive character customization, collectible pets, robust PvP and PvE experiences, and much more.

#IGN #Gaming #gamescom

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Murals - Official Reveal Trailer | gamescom 2026
Take a look at the Reveal Trailer for Murals, a hack-and-slash action game developed by Dlala Studios. Players will explore hand-painted worlds portraying beloved fairytales that have gone completely awry. Murals is coming soon to PC (Steam).

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Monster Hunter Outlanders - Mobile Trailer | gamescom 2026
Monster Hunter Outlanders, an exploration hunting action game by Capcom and TiMi Studio Group, comes to mobile platforms. Pre-register now to take up the old weapons in a new world.

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Lofsöng - Official Gameplay Trailer | gamescom 2026
Lofsöng took center stage at gamescom's Opening Night Live, and the team at Unrelated Games gave us a new look at the game set on a dead Earth, where a childlike traveler crosses the Dust Sea and enters the forbidden Exclusion Zone. Fortunately, he's guided by a shapeshifting origami companion.

To complete this mission, players will need to use singing and sound-based interaction to uncover the memories of lost humanities embedded in "monumental architectures of stone, resonance, and silence."

#IGN #Gaming #gamescom

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Acornia: Mirror Worlds - Official Reveal Trailer | gamescom 2026
Here's a look at the Reveal Trailer for Acornia: Mirror Worlds, a bake-and-brawl adventure management game developed by Splashteam. Players will manage the challenges of two linear dimensions, with one requiring players to fight against disgruntled spirits and the other requiring the management of a shop. Serve or shoot in Acornia: Mirror Worlds, coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Sea of Remnants - Official Gameplay Trailer | gamescom 2026
"Brave the gale." Get a peek at gameplay, combat, and mysterious locations from Sea of Remnants in this latest trailer for the upcoming ocean adventure RPG. Sea of Remnants will be available on PC and PlayStation 5 (PS5). Pre-registration is available now via the game's official website.

As a puppetfolk sailor seeking lost memories, you’ll brave dynamic seas, battle strange monsters, build your fleet, bond with companions, and shape the evolving pirate city of Orbtopia through every choice you make in Sea of Remnants.

#IGN #Gaming #gamescom

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Perceptum - Official Release Window Trailer | gamescom 2026
Take a look at Perceptum in this unsettling new trailer for the upcoming psychological horror game where you play as a medium investigating the disappearance of a family. In Perceptum, explore a house with an oppressive atmosphere, close your eyes to hear the beyond, use your mirror to see what should not exist and uncover the truth hidden within its walls. Perceptum will be available on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store), Xbox Series X/S, and PlayStation 5 (PS5) in spring 2027.

#IGN #Gaming #gamescom

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Cosmo Tales - Official Early Access Release Date Trailer | gamescom 2026
Get a fresh look at gameplay and the colorful sci-fi setting of Cosmo Tales in this early access release date trailer for the upcoming family-friendly roguelite adventure game. In Cosmo Tales, play as a talking car, battle through a vibrant sci-fi universe, and craft unique builds in a world shaped by ever-changing dimensions. Cosmo Tales will be available in Early Access on PC on September 3, 2026. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3601630/Cosmo_Tales/

#IGN #Gaming #gamescom

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Transport Fever 3 - Official Release Date Trailer | gamescom 2026
"Conquer land. Conquer air. Conquer water. Conquer the world. Conquer time." Transport Fever 3 gets a new trailer showcasing gameplay and a release date. Watch the latest Transport Fever 3 trailer for this upcoming transport tycoon sim game. Transport Fever 3 will be available on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store), PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S on September 29, 2026.

Transport Fever 3, the ultimate transport tycoon returns, bigger, deeper, and more dynamic than ever. Build the routes that transform the world across land, sea, and sky using over a century of evolving transport options. Design and build your ideal transport network.

text:
Avengers Endgame: Encore - Official Trailer (2026) Robert Downey Jr., Chris Evans
Don't miss the Official Trailer for Avengers Endgame: Encore, the re-release of the seminal installment of the Marvel Cinematic Universe, distributed by Marvel Studios. Fans can relive the Battle of Earth with new scenes leading up to Avengers: Doomsday in Avengers Endgame: Encore, in theaters on September 25.

Witness the battle of a lifetime as the Avengers pick up the pieces of Infinity War, embark on a grand time heist, and make a heartfelt sacrifice that rippled through all of humanity. Assemble once more in the re-release of Avengers Endgame with Avengers Endgame: Encore.

Avengers Endgame: Encore stars Robert Downey Jr., Chris Evans, Mark Ruffalo, Chris Hemsworth, Josh Brolin, Scarlett Johansson, and more. The film is directed Anthony and Joe Russo alongside being written by Christopher Markus, Stephen McFeely, and Stan Lee.

Avengers Endgame: Encore is in theaters on September 25.
